design_philosophy.identity: Warm & Human, modern, and technological. The platform must avoid looking cold, sterile, or overly institutional.
design_philosophy.positioning: La plateforme qui connecte les talents éducatifs aux écoles et aux apprenants.
design_philosophy.hero_title: Trouvez le bon éducateur. Trouvez la bonne opportunité.

rules: Use Blue (#2a4898) for primary trust actions, headers, and major structural elements.
Use Orange (#F8BF0E) for high-energy accents, highlights, primary conversion CTAs, and Premium/Family Pass badges.
Never use pure black or pure white for backgrounds. Always use the slightly warm #FDFBF7 for the main app background to reinforce the 'Warm & Human' feel.
Ensure sufficient contrast for accessibility (WCAG AA). If placing white text on the orange button, check contrast or use a very dark blue/black text on the orange CTA for readability.

headings.usage: All titles, H1-H6, hero texts, and card titles.

body.usage: Highly legible for all body text, paragraphs, labels, and UI text.

rules: Do NOT use Inter for headings.
Use 'Poppins' exclusively for large display text and section titles.
Ensure all text has minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio against its background.

general.philosophy: Generous Spacing (p-6, p-8) to ensure the platform feels accessible, breathable, and simple.

landing_page.grid_mode: The 'Tetris' Grid (Asymmetrical and engaging) or 'Swiss' inspired clean sections with overlapping elements.
landing_page.hero_composition: Massive H1 (Poppins), engaging Subtitle, overlapping embedded search bar with filters (Subject, Level, Location, Type) floating over or right below the text, alongside warm human photography.
landing_page.features_section: Bento grid with generous white space and subtle orange/blue accent borders.

dashboards.grid_mode: High Density Grid for functionality, but retaining soft radii.
dashboards.navigation: Responsive: Mobile-first bottom navigation + hamburger menu for secondary items. Side navigation for Desktop.
dashboards.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Left-align dense data, tables, and forms.

radii.buttons: rounded-full or rounded-xl (slightly rounded as requested)

buttons.primary: bg-[#2a4898] text-white hover:bg-[#203a7a] transition-colors rounded-xl px-6 py-3 font-medium
buttons.accent: bg-[#F8BF0E] text-[#111827] hover:bg-[#e0ab0c] transition-colors rounded-xl px-6 py-3 font-semibold
buttons.outline: border-2 border-[#2a4898] text-[#2a4898] hover:bg-[#eef2fb] rounded-xl px-6 py-3 font-medium

cards.style: bg-white border border-gray-100 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow rounded-2xl p-6
cards.educator_card: Includes educator photo, verified badge, rating (stars), subjects/levels tags, and 'Book' CTA.

inputs.style: bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 focus:border-[#2a4898] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2a4898]/20 rounded-lg p-3 w-full transition-all

badges.premium: bg-gradient-to-r from-[#F8BF0E] to-[#e0ab0c] text-black text-xs font-bold px-2 py-1 rounded-md uppercase
badges.verified: bg-[#10B981]/10 text-[#10B981] flex items-center gap-1 text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded-md
badges.match_score: bg-[#2a4898]/10 text-[#2a4898] font-bold px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-sm (e.g., '92% Compatible')

icons.style: Simple, clean line icons, primarily in the #2a4898 (blue) or #4B5563 (slate) color.

testing.rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-search-button').

motion.hover_states: -translate-y-1 transform transition-all duration-300 ease-out on cards. Scale 1.02 on primary buttons.
motion.page_transitions: Subtle fade-in (opacity 0 to 1) for dashboard views.

hero_main.description: Group of joyful African children. Perfect for the hero section or 'Parents/Learners' section to evoke warmth and accessibility.

educator_profile_1.description: African woman working on laptop. Excellent for representing an adult learner, a private tutor, or school administrator.

educator_profile_2.description: Teacher actively instructing in front of a class. Perfect for the 'Schools' journey or 'CV Library' marketing.

students_warm.description: Two African boys smiling. Represents the Family Pass, private tutoring success, and proximity.

media.style: Photos must depict the Senegalese/African context. Focus on warmth, smiles, and professional/educational settings. Avoid clinical or overly corporate imagery.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a robust layout using pure HTML/Tailwind for marketing pages and Shadcn components for complex dashboard logic.
Implement a theme provider to ensure background is #FDFBF7 by default.
Install Google Fonts 'Poppins' and 'Figtree'. Ensure Poppins is used exclusively for H1-H6.
Create the embedded search component immediately below the Hero Text. It must include Subject, Level, Location, and Service Type dropdowns.
For the dashboards, ensure the navigation shifts from a side-nav (desktop) to a bottom-nav + hamburger menu (mobile).
Use lucide-react for all iconography to maintain simple, modern visuals.
Ensure the match compatibility score ('92% compatible') is visually prominent on tutor profile cards.
Add 'data-testid' to ALL buttons, inputs, links, and forms.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.avoid_slop: Do not make generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical grids (Bento) for marketing. Create depth through layered design elements and subtle shadows.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.spacing: Use 2x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.motion: Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, subtle entrance fades). Static = dead.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.component_reuse: Prioritize reusing Shadcn components from src/components/ui.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.css_rule: NEVER apply 'transition: all' globally. NEVER center align the main App container globally.
